videos.headline: Oklahoma State gets tricky for a long gain
videos.description: Mason Rudolph passes the ball to Chris Carson, but the trick play is on as Carson gives it right back to Rudolph, who takes off 24 yards for an Oklahoma State first down.

videos.headline: Oklahoma State pulls off a double-pass trick play
videos.description: Chris Carson pass complete to Mason Rudolph for 24 yds to the Colo 10 for a 1ST down

videos.headline: Chris Carson runs it in for an Oklahoma State TD
videos.description: Chris Carson gets the handoff and runs 10 yards for a touchdown to give Oklahoma State a 10-0 lead.

videos.headline: Rudolph finds Washington for another Oklahoma State TD
videos.description: Mason Rudolph throws to James Washington, who gets into the end zone for a five-yard touchdown, giving Oklahoma State a 17-0 lead over Colorado.

videos.headline: S. Montez pass to P. Lindsay for 38 yds for a 1ST down
videos.description: Steven Montez pass complete to Phillip Lindsay for 38 yds to the OKSt 38 for a 1ST down

videos.headline: S. Montez pass intercepted, A. Lampkin return for 1 yd
videos.description: Steven Montez pass intercepted Ashton Lampkin return for 1 yd to the OKSt 3

videos.headline: Rudolph throws another TD pass for Oklahoma State
videos.description: Mason Rudolph throws to Blake Jarwin, who gets into the end zone for a 6-yard touchdown to give Oklahoma State a 24-0 lead over Colorado.

videos.headline: Rudolph throws third TD pass to continue Cowboys' rout
videos.description: Mason Rudolph finds Jhajuan Seales for a 23-yard touchdown to give Oklahoma State a 31-0 lead over Colorado.

videos.headline: Liufau gets Colorado on the board with a TD
videos.description: Sefo Liufau rushes for a 6-yard touchdown, making the score 31-6.
